verses.text: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.

segments.text: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven,
Whose sin is covered.

verses.text: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.

segments.text: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity,
And in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.

segments.text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away
Through my groaning all the day long.

verses.text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed as with the drought of summer. [Selah

verses.text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. [Selah

verses.text: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.

segments.text: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found:

verses.text: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. [Selah

segments.text: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble;

verses.text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.

segments.text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go:

verses.text: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, Else they will not come near unto thee.

verses.text: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he that trusteth in Jehovah, lovingkindness shall compass him about.

verses.text: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
